scope: Durable routing of the completed exact migration; no new deletion or claim about all shared-cache entries. Current source absence/hash/device verification is separate from the retained earlier copy/use/delete observations.
rederive: Retained original migration record identifies the unique run, size and SHA; full prior-run job identity links it to rdje/fsmgen and the remote revision. Fresh current hash/device/source-residue verification checks the retained local object and exact old filename only.
falsify: Original after-delete local-cache query returns identical complete failed-log output without recreating the old record, separating local use from old-cache fallback. No original workflow success or global cache absence is inferred.
durability: Byte-exact original operational record and compressed full prior-run inventory, current check/recipe receipt, existing locality card/book, focused doctrine/normal hook and task commit.
external_read: Exact prior user GH cache filename is inspected read-only solely to verify residue; shared config/keychain remain required read-only authentication inputs. No other repository is written.
